verdict.rationale: OCI documents the CLI as providing 'the same core functionality as the Console, plus additional commands', which implies platform-wide breadth rather than flagship-only coverage. It also describes typical REST APIs, an API change policy with 12 months' notice, SDKs with documentation, and a Terraform provider spanning OCI services. However, the pack contains no per-service API/CLI reference pages and nothing showing those references are consistent across services, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service API and CLI reference pages, demonstrated consistency of reference docs across non-flagship services, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of reference quality.
